about: The `money_edges` table, published whole. See /api/schema for its grain.

rows.why: Money in fund 0100 is fungible and no record ties a source to a department. The town apportions by share when presenting a budget; that is a convention, not a flow. **No further data will fix this.**

The fund is athletics — established from its cash journal. But **no expense report exists for special revenue funds**, so what it actually paid for is not observed. The general-fund athletics line (function 3510) is a separate, traced thing.
Same gap — and see the assumption below about whether this is the same money as the general-fund `SCHCOSTREI` line.
School choice money is not restricted the way a program revolving fund is. Where it is spent is not established here at all.
Restricted by the grant award rather than by a town vote, and equally unobserved.
The assessment covers town and school employees together. No published document gives the split.
The account name states it and it sits beside the town-retiree equivalent.
Not appropriated by Lunenburg, not in our archive, and not sized anywhere here.
